fusions.name: Lodged Barb
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 6 damage and leaves a barbed link in the target: it is [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and moves 15% slower for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Swarm Relay
fusions.desc: The swarm deals 25 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds, then leaps to 3 more enemies within 4 tiles for 50% of the damage.

fusions.name: Of One Hive
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more Power.

fusions.name: Stinger Handoff
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, a barbed link flies to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage, then leaps to 1 more within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 3 seconds.
